item.text:
`Simulator` no longer knows about `SimulatorView` or Swing. It now publishes `SimulationState` snapshots to registered `SimulationObserver`s in [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Simulator.java:12), with the observer contract in [SimulationObserver.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulationObserver.java:1) and the immutable snapshot in [SimulationState.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulationState.java:1). Viability is now derived from the published state instead of from the view.

`SimulatorView` was moved to the consumer side of that boundary. It implements `SimulationObserver` and renders `onStateChanged(...)` in [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/SimulatorView.java:16). `Main` is now the composition root that creates the simulator and view, binds button actions to simulator commands, and registers the observer in [Main.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R004_module_java/Main.java:5).
